title: Patch: drop the at-a-glance Token and Created marks, keep them in the hover preview
thread:
**Issue #2647 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2647: Patch: drop the at-a-glance Token and Created marks, keep them in the hover preview
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

A card's **Token** and **Created** status almost never matters in combat, yet both show on the card at a glance: the "T" / "Token" plate (R1177001) and the "Created" pill (R943). They clutter the board, the hand and the backrow. This patch takes both off the card faces and keeps them in the **hover preview** (the inspect popup), where a player who wants to know can still find out.

**What goes:**
- **The token mark** (`TokenMark`, `.cf-token`, `apps/web/src/cards/CardFace.tsx`): the "T" or "Token" plate a face wears where its type line doesn't show (a small face, the phone, most face-up backrow cards, a full-art face), and the one the board minion wears between attack and health (`apps/web/src/cards/MinionFace.tsx`, the `<TokenMark face={face} />` in its stats row).
- **The Created pill** (`kind: "created"` in `stateBadges`, `apps/web/src/cards/cardState.ts`), drawn on faces by `CardStates` (`apps/web/src/cards/CardStates.tsx`) and styled in `apps/web/src/cards/cardstate.css` (`.cf-state[data-state="created"]`).

**What stays:**
- The hover preview still says both. A full face's type line keeps "Token Unit" / "Token Spell" (on a Chinese face 衍生物…). The inspect state notes (`apps/web/src/cards/inspect/StateNotes.tsx`, which list `stateBadges`) keep the "Created: made during the game" line.
- `created` and `token` stay in the wire and the views exactly as they are. This patch only changes what the client draws. No engine, card or catalog change.
- Wherever else the full-word label is part of a full face (the Almanac's "Token, printed Legendary", the collection's full face), it stays. Only the small at-a-glance marks go.

**Rulings to amend in this PR (CLAUDE.md rule 3):**
- **R1177001** says that where the type line doesn't show, the face wears a token mark, and the board minion wears it too. That changes: no mark on those faces, and the hover preview's full face and type line carry the word.
- **R943** ends "The client shows it as a small 'Created' mark." That changes: the client shows it only in the hover preview's state notes.
- Add a new ruling in this issue's block (R<N>000) that says this and why: the status is rarely relevant in combat, so it lives in the hover preview. Cite it from the changed code and the amended notes, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`. Run `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A token on the board (`MinionFace`) renders no `.cf-token` / `[data-token="true"]` element and no "T" between its attack and health.
- [ ] A small, full-art or compact token face with no type line renders no token mark.
- [ ] A full token face (the hover preview's) still reads "Token Unit" / "Token Spell" in its type line, including the Chinese form.
- [ ] A Created card's face (board, hand, backrow) renders no `.cf-state[data-state="created"]` badge.
- [ ] The inspect state notes for a Created card still list the Created line (`data-state="created"`).
- [ ] Glitch is unchanged (it already wore neither, R674).
- [ ] Update or remove the tests that assert the old marks (`CardFace.test.tsx`, `cardState.test.tsx`, `almanac.test.tsx` and any others that find them), with a test named after the new ruling that proves the marks are gone from the faces and still in the hover preview.
- [ ] Remove the unused CSS (`.cf-token*` and the created pill rules) and any constants that only served them (`TOKEN_GLYPH`, etc.) if nothing else reads them.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass. If an e2e spec looks for the marks, update it as well.

## Blocked by, part of

None.
```
